name: shiro-core
services:
  core:
    container_name: mx-server
    depends_on:
      mx-migrate:
        condition: service_completed_successfully
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      ALLOWED_ORIGINS: localhost,127.0.0.1
      CDN_CACHE_HEADER: "true"
      ENCRYPT_ENABLE: "false"
      ENCRYPT_KEY: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      FORCE_CACHE_HEADER: "false"
      JWT_SECRET: validation-only-jwt-secret-with-sufficient-length
      NODE_ENV: production
      PG_DATABASE: mx_core
      PG_HOST: postgres
      PG_PASSWORD: validation-password
      PG_PORT: "5432"
      PG_USER: mx
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      SNOWFLAKE_WORKER_ID: "1"
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -f
        - http://127.0.0.1:2333/api/v3/ping
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    image: innei/mx-server:latest
    networks:
      mx-space: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 2333
        published: "2333"
        protocol: tcp
    pull_policy: always
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/runner/work/Shiro/Shiro/data/mx-space
        target: /root/.mx-space
        bind:
          create_host_path: true
  mx-migrate:
    command:
      - node
      - migrate.mjs
    container_name: mx-migrate
    depends_on:
      postgres:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
      redis:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      ALLOWED_ORIGINS: localhost,127.0.0.1
      CDN_CACHE_HEADER: "true"
      ENCRYPT_ENABLE: "false"
      ENCRYPT_KEY: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
      FORCE_CACHE_HEADER: "false"
      JWT_SECRET: validation-only-jwt-secret-with-sufficient-length
      NODE_ENV: production
      PG_DATABASE: mx_core
      PG_HOST: postgres
      PG_PASSWORD: validation-password
      PG_PORT: "5432"
      PG_USER: mx
      REDIS_HOST: redis
      REDIS_PORT: "6379"
      SNOWFLAKE_WORKER_ID: "1"
      TZ: Asia/Shanghai
    image: innei/mx-server:latest
    networks:
      mx-space: null
    pull_policy: always
    restart: "no"
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/runner/work/Shiro/Shiro/data/mx-space
        target: /root/.mx-space
        bind:
          create_host_path: true
  postgres:
    container_name: mx-postgres
    environment:
      POSTGRES_DB: mx_core
      POSTGRES_PASSWORD: validation-password
      POSTGRES_USER: mx
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - pg_isready -U mx -d mx_core
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
    image: postgres:16-alpine
    networks:
      mx-space: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/runner/work/Shiro/Shiro/data/postgres
        target: /var/lib/postgresql/data
        bind:
          create_host_path: true
  redis:
    command:
      - redis-server
      - --appendonly
      - "yes"
    container_name: mx-redis
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD-SHELL
        - redis-cli ping | grep PONG
      timeout: 5s
      interval: 15s
      retries: 10
      start_period: 10s
    image: redis:7-alpine
    networks:
      mx-space: null
    restart: unless-stopped
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: /home/runner/work/Shiro/Shiro/data/redis
        target: /data
        bind:
          create_host_path: true
  shiro:
    build:
      context: /home/runner/work/Shiro/Shiro
      dockerfile: Dockerfile
      args:
        NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://core:2333/api/v3
        NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_API_URL: http://localhost:2333/api/v3
        NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:2333
    container_name: shiro
    depends_on:
      core:
        condition: service_healthy
        required: true
    environment:
      GH_TOKEN: ""
      NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL: http://core:2333/api/v3
      NEXT_PUBLIC_CLIENT_API_URL: http://localhost:2333/api/v3
      NEXT_PUBLIC_GATEWAY_URL: http://localhost:2333
      NODE_ENV: production
      PORT: "2323"
      S3_ACCESS_KEY: ""
      S3_SECRET_KEY: ""
      TMDB_API_KEY: ""
      WEBHOOK_SECRET: ""
    healthcheck:
      test:
        - CMD
        - curl
        - -fsS
        - http://127.0.0.1:2323/api/health
      timeout: 10s
      interval: 30s
      retries: 5
      start_period: 30s
    image: felixzoe/shiro:core-v3
    networks:
      mx-space: null
    ports:
      - mode: ingress
        target: 2323
        published: "2323"
        protocol: tcp
    restart: unless-stopped
networks:
  mx-space:
    name: shiro-core_mx-space
    driver: bridge
x-core-env:
  ALLOWED_ORIGINS: localhost,127.0.0.1
  CDN_CACHE_HEADER: "true"
  ENCRYPT_ENABLE: "false"
  ENCRYPT_KEY: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
  FORCE_CACHE_HEADER: "false"
  JWT_SECRET: validation-only-jwt-secret-with-sufficient-length
  NODE_ENV: production
  PG_DATABASE: mx_core
  PG_HOST: postgres
  PG_PASSWORD: validation-password
  PG_PORT: "5432"
  PG_USER: mx
  REDIS_HOST: redis
  REDIS_PORT: "6379"
  SNOWFLAKE_WORKER_ID: "1"
  TZ: Asia/Shanghai
